name: Kizuato
source:
The protagonist, Kashiwagi Kouichi, and his father had lived apart. 
One month has already passed since his father's sudden death in an accident. Kouichi cancelled a long-awaited trip with his friends and decided to visit his old house in the countryside to revere father's memory - at least during a long summer break at university and until the forty-ninth day after his father's death. 

His cousins, having lost their parents at a very young age and having been raised by his father, stopped passing their days in sorrow and began to slowly return their smiles. The girls joyfully welcomed the protagonist but still had deep scars in their hearts. Yet one case mercilessly ripped the hearts of the girls...

[Edited from the [url=https://leaf.aquaplus.jp/product/kizuato/story.html]official site[/url]]

主人公�的木�浩一和父亲一直分居两地。父亲在事故中突然去世已经过去了一个月。浩一取消了期待已久的朋友旅行，决定前往乡下的老宅祭奠父亲——至少在大学的长假期间，直到父亲去世后的第四十九天。

他的表妹们在非常年幼时就失去了父母，由他的父亲抚养长大。她们已经不再终日以泪洗面，开始慢慢恢复笑容。女孩们高兴地欢迎了主人公，但心中仍然有着深深的伤痕。然而一起事件无情地撕裂了女孩们的心……
